title: POV: The 2 A.M. Gate (Revised)

style_bible.character: One woman, about 30, long straight dark hair past the shoulders worn down, slim build, natural makeup, small gold hoop earrings.
style_bible.wardrobe: Cream chunky ribbed crewneck sweater, dark trousers and white sneakers in every shot (no heels, no blouse, no robe).
style_bible.setting: A deserted airport gate and concourse at night, then a calm sunlit hotel room the next morning.
style_bible.color_grade: Cool desaturated teal at the airport, shifting to warm golden sunrise tones in the hotel with clean premium contrast.
style_bible.lens_and_light: 35-50mm shallow depth of field, soft motivated light: dim fluorescent and screen glow at night, golden side light at sunrise.

scenes.description: Hook: a stranded traveler at a dead-empty gate at 2am lowers the phone from her ear and exhales. Her black carry-on is beside her knee, empty gate seats and runway lights sit behind her, and a departure board glows red but is fully blurred.
scenes.camera: Handheld medium-close, slight drift, starting close on her face and phone.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, long straight dark hair past shoulders, gold hoops, cream chunky ribbed sweater: seated at a deserted airport gate at night, lowers phone from her ear and exhales, black carry-on beside her knee, empty gate seats, heavily blurred red-glowing departure board behind, no legible text. Handheld medium-close, slight drift. Dim cool fluorescent light, runway lights in dark window.

scenes.description: Over-shoulder insert: she glances at her phone, which shows only a soft out-of-focus glow. Her face relaxes into a relieved smile. The overlay carries the product role.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder from behind her left shoulder, slow push-in.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, long straight dark hair past shoulders, gold hoops, cream chunky ribbed sweater: same night gate, glances down at her phone, tension melts into a small relieved smile. Over-shoulder from behind her left shoulder, phone screen a soft blank glow, out of focus and angled away. Slow push-in. Dim cool gate light, warm screen glow on her cheek.

scenes.description: She walks away down the empty concourse rolling her carry-on. The chunky cream sweater and long dark hair are clearly visible from behind as she moves toward warmer light.
scenes.camera: Steady low gimbal follow from behind at walking pace.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, long straight dark hair past shoulders, gold hoops, cream chunky ribbed sweater, dark trousers, white sneakers: walks away from camera down an empty night concourse, rolling a black carry-on, hair over the chunky knit clearly visible from behind. Low gimbal follow at walking pace. Glossy floor, cool overhead light warming toward the exit ahead.

scenes.description: Resolution at the hotel the next morning. She wears the same sweater, with the same hair and face. She stands beside a sunlit window, sips from a matte mug and smiles calmly. The window glass sits out of frame, so there are no reflections. A clean wall above her leaves space for the end card.
scenes.camera: Static medium shot from the side with a gentle slow drift; upper third left empty.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, long straight dark hair past shoulders, gold hoops, cream chunky ribbed sweater (location change: hotel room next morning, same outfit and hair): stands beside a sunlit window, sips from a matte white mug, calm confident smile. Side medium shot, glass out of frame, no reflections. Static, slow drift. Warm golden sunrise light, plain soft-lit wall fills empty upper third.

end_card.headline: Because delays happen. Be covered when they do.

sound: Shots 1-2: quiet airport hum, distant PA murmur with no words and a soft tired exhale. A single warm piano note lands on her smile. Shot 3: rolling suitcase wheels, then a minimal modern pulse builds. Shot 4: soft morning birds and a light clink of the mug as the music resolves into a confident, premium sting under the end card.
